verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents a general 'transaction rules' engine that can auto-approve/decline authorizations based on business logic (docs-3, docs-23), which is the mechanism that would enforce spend controls platform-side rather than in the ops user's own code. However, the evidence never specifies configurable amount caps over daily/monthly/all-time windows, per-cardholder vs per-card limits, or transaction-count velocity rules — these specific spend-control primitives are not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of amount-cap windows (daily/monthly/all-time), per-card vs per-cardholder limit configuration, and velocity/transaction-count rule support.
